records.source: @,^^You never showed up at the boat, so I went lookin' for ya.^^Found you sprawled out in the dirt, with a couple o' parrots pulling gold out of your pockets!^^Had to drag you all the way down to the boat. Me legs feel like two freshwater shrimp...^-Willy
records.translation: @,^^Hindi ka dumating sa bangka, kaya hinanap kita.^^Natagpuan kitang nakahandusay sa lupa habang may dalawang lorong kumukuha ng ginto sa mga bulsa mo!^^Kinailangan kitang kaladkarin hanggang sa bangka. Parang dalawang hipong-tabang ang mga binti ko...^-Willy

records.source: Hi @,^^Last night, I found you slumbering in the dark.^It wasn't a very safe place, so the bird friends air-lifted you to your bed.^Please be careful from now on.^^-Leo^^P.S. Willy helped me write this.
records.translation: Kumusta, @,^^Kagabi, natagpuan kitang natutulog sa dilim.^Hindi gaanong ligtas ang lugar na iyon, kaya inilipad ka ng mga kaibigang ibon patungo sa higaan mo.^Mag-ingat ka sana mula ngayon.^^-Leo^^P.S. Tinulungan ako ni Willy na isulat ito.

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks for all the bones. I've got a lot to sort through here! To think, each fragment belonged to a living, breathing body from the past. Fascinating.^^Please accept this unique crafting recipe as a thank-you gift!^^-Gunther%item craftingRecipe Bone_Mill %%[#]Gunther's Note
records.translation: Kumusta, @,^^Salamat sa lahat ng buto. Marami akong kailangang suriin dito! Isiping ang bawat tipak ay dating bahagi ng isang nabubuhay at humihingang katawan mula sa nakaraan. Kahanga-hanga.^^Tanggapin mo sana ang natatanging resipe sa paglikhang ito bilang regalo ng pasasalamat!^^-Gunther%item craftingRecipe Bone_Mill %%[#]Liham ni Gunther

records.source: @,^Here's a food from my home, that me and my family enjoy. Hope you like it. ^^  -Leo^^P.S. Willy helped me write this.%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Leo's Recipe
records.translation: @,^Narito ang isang pagkain mula sa tahanan ko na gusto namin ng pamilya ko. Sana magustuhan mo. ^^  -Leo^^P.S. Tinulungan ako ni Willy na isulat ito.%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Resipe ni Leo

records.source: Hello.^^I've heard you're working on a very special challenge.^^I have the 'perfect' solution to help you out.^^Meet me in the watery cave on Ginger Island.^^-Fizz^Joja Special Services Division[#]Letter From Fizz
records.translation: Kumusta.^^Nabalitaan kong sinisikap mong tapusin ang isang napakaespesyal na hamon.^^Mayroon akong 'perpektong' solusyon upang tulungan ka.^^Makipagkita ka sa akin sa matubig na yungib sa Isla ng Luya.^^-Fizz^Dibisyon ng mga Espesyal na Serbisyo ng Joja[#]Liham mula kay Fizz

records.source: Saw the weather report last night.^^I'm not sure what will happen, but if anyone wants to take shelter in the Saloon, I'll keep it open all day.^^-Gus[#]Shelter In The Saloon
records.translation: Nakita ko ang ulat-panahon kagabi.^^Hindi ko tiyak kung ano ang mangyayari, pero kung may gustong sumilong sa Saloon ng Patak-Bituin, pananatilihin ko itong bukas buong araw.^^-Gus[#]Silungan sa Saloon

records.source: Dear @,^^Tomorrow begins a 3-day festival in Calico Desert.^^With the bus back in order, we're all delighted to be able to continue this time-honored, beloved tradition.^^There will be games, free food, prizes, and much more!^^Also, two townspeople are selected each day to run a little shop, so make sure you swing by and check out what they have to offer.^^See you there!^-Lewis[#]Desert Festival Reminder
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^^Magsisimula bukas ang tatlong-araw na pista sa Disyerto ng Calico.^^Ngayong maayos na muli ang bus, tuwang-tuwa kaming lahat na maipagpatuloy ang minamahal at matagal nang tradisyong ito.^^Magkakaroon ng mga laro, libreng pagkain, premyo, at marami pang iba!^^Bukod dito, dalawang tagabayan ang pinipili bawat araw upang magpatakbo ng munting tindahan, kaya tiyaking dumaan at tingnan ang kanilang mga paninda.^^Magkita tayo roon!^-Lewis[#]Paalala sa Pista sa Disyerto

records.source: Dear @,^^From what I can tell, you've been taking really good care of your pet! I'm really happy about that!^^But there are many sweet animals that need a home... If you're interested, I'll start offering pet adoptions at my shop.^^Just be aware that there is a licensing fee, and also that each pet will want their own outdoor pet bowl area, or else they'll be unhappy. Robin will be happy to construct additional pet bowls, for a price.^^See you soon!^-Marnie[#]Pet Adoptions Letter
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^^Sa nakikita ko, napakahusay mong inaalagaan ang alaga mo! Tuwang-tuwa ako riyan!^^Pero maraming mababait na hayop ang nangangailangan ng tahanan... Kung interesado ka, magsisimula akong mag-alok ng pag-aampon ng mga alaga sa tindahan ko.^^Tandaan lamang na may bayad sa lisensya at gugustuhin ng bawat alaga ang sarili nitong Mangkok ng Alaga sa labas, kung hindi ay malulungkot ito. Masayang gagawa si Robin ng mga karagdagang Mangkok ng Alaga kapalit ng bayad.^^Magkita tayo agad!^-Marnie[#]Liham tungkol sa Pag-aampon ng Alaga

records.source: Dear @,^^I hope this letter finds you well.^^I know you decided against adopting a pet when I last asked. However, if you've changed your mind, I am now offering pet adoptions from my shop.^^See you around!^-Marnie[#]Pet Adoptions Letter
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^^Sana ay nasa mabuti kang kalagayan.^^Alam kong nagpasiya kang huwag mag-ampon ng alaga noong huli akong nagtanong. Gayunman, kung nagbago ang isip mo, nag-aalok na ako ngayon ng pag-aampon ng mga alaga sa tindahan ko.^^Magkita tayo!^-Marnie[#]Liham tungkol sa Pag-aampon ng Alaga

records.source: Watching a movie with mom sure brings me back!
records.translation: Talagang nagbabalik ng mga alaala ang panonood ng pelikula kasama si Nanay!
(Matiim na nanonood sina Pam at Penny!)

records.source: It's great to be able to do things as a family again!
records.translation: Napakasayang muli kaming nakagagawa ng mga bagay-bagay bilang pamilya!

records.source: I'm looking forward to this! Jas and Vincent have been talking about it non-stop.
records.translation: Sabik na ako rito! Walang tigil na pinag-uusapan ito nina Jas at Vincent.

records.source: Wow, it must be really hard leaving his family like that...$s
records.translation: Wow, napakahirap sigurong iwan nang ganoon ang pamilya niya...$s

records.source: Penny seems to be holding back some tears...
records.translation: Tila pinipigil ni Penny ang kaniyang mga luha...
